notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Language patch.
Had to change some level names.

notes.title: Bug Patch
notes.notes:
A couple of things that are a part of this update:

 Fixed a bug where restarting the level does not reset crates or bubbles.
 Adjusted the character's animation so that the direction they are facing is no longer based off of momentum but on user input.

notes.title: Bug Patch
notes.notes:
A few bugs have been found and we squashed them!

Fixed a bug that caused crates to collide with uninstantiated blocks in the level editor.
Fixed a bug where standing on blocks at a specific y-coordinate would crash the game.
